subject: TDX.ai follow-up: schedule ML/infra deep-dive
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma@tdx.ai>, Samir Khan <samir@tdx.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-15T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Quick recap + proposing ML/infra deep-dive (60–90m)

Hi Emma / Samir —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery: TDX.ai is evaluating a hosted inference solution for your customer-facing recommendation pipeline (span: 4–8 tokens per inference; expected peak 120 req/s), with strong constraints around 99th-pct latency (<120ms) and predictable cost per 1M tokens. You mentioned interest in a private VPC deployment if the security posture and egress controls check out.

Next step: propose a 60–90 minute technical deep-dive with our ML/infra engineers to walk through:
- workload profile and synthetic replay (you bring samples/traffic shape)
- performance & latency targets and how we map to node sizing
- KV cache / batching strategy and expected unit economics
- private deployment options (VPC, KMS/HSM) and audit logs
- integration points (SDKs, streaming, function call patterns)
- rollout plan + success criteria

Proposed times (PT):
- Thu Mar 18 | 10:00–11:15 PT
- Fri Mar 19 | 14:00–15:30 PT (preferred for us)

Can you confirm which slot works and who from your side will attend (ML lead, infra, security/ops)? If useful, we can also share a short pre-read and a Drive folder with sample prompts/log schema.

I've attached a suggested agenda and a short checklist we use for deep-dive prep.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[karthik@redwood.com]
[Attachment: redwood-tdx-deep-dive-agenda.pdf (PDF, 48KB)]

From: Emma Li <emma@tdx.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Khan <samir@tdx.ai>
Date: 2026-03-16T09:28:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + proposing ML/infra deep-dive (60–90m)

Hi Karthik —

Thanks for the clear recap. Friday Mar 19 14:00 PT (17:00 ET) should work best for our team. I'll be joined by Samir (ML) and I want to include Priya Narayanan (security/compliance) on the call — she handles SOC2 readiness and data residency questions.

Two quick asks before the deep-dive:
1) Can you confirm whether someone from your team can cover SOC2/audit-log retention and KMS integration?
2) We'll send a short security questionnaire (baseline) — can you take a look and flag anything not applicable?

I attached the questionnaire we're used to sending to vendors. If you can loop in an infra engineer and a CS contact to the invite that would be great.

Best,
Emma Li
Head of Product & Partnerships | TDX.ai
[emma@tdx.ai]
[Attachment: tdx-security-questions.xlsx (XLSX, 72KB)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>

Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-16T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + proposing ML/infra deep-dive (60–90m)

Emma — great, thanks for confirming and for the questionnaire. Looping in the engineers and CS lead:
- Jonas Weber, Senior Infrastructure Engineer (jonas@redwood.com) — will lead the infra deep-dive and cover VPC/KMS/audit log options
- Monica Patel, Customer Success Manager (monica@redwood.com) — will coordinate pre-reads and rollout plan

Jonas / Monica — Emma asked for SOC2 and KMS/audit-log coverage; I've attached our standard deep-dive agenda and a short pre-read with performance expectations. Please review and flag any other artifacts we should share in advance (e.g., sample cURLs, replay harness).

Proposed final schedule: Fri Mar 19, 14:00–15:30 PT (90 minutes). I'll send a calendar invite once we confirm.

Priority items to cover first (so Priya can drop if needed):
- VPC controls, KMS/HSM support, audit logs (15–20m)
- Workload replay + latency walk-through (25–30m)
- Batching/caching strategy and cost modeling (20m)
- Integration checklist & next steps (10–15m)

[Attachment: redwood-tdx-deep-dive-agenda.pdf (PDF, 48KB)]

Karthik
